glance.summary: OpenAI raised $11 billion in funding at a $1.25 trillion valuation.
Anthropic is using AI models to automate AI development, doubling model improvement speed.
Meta abandoned updated business terms that allowed collecting website content for AI training.
U.S. voters voted to impose more restrictions on data center development in all but one of 41 midterm ballot measures.

big_pour.headline: Anthropic uses AI to speed up AI building
big_pour.summary: Anthropic is using AI to build more powerful models, with development speed doubling compared to last year according to a report by METR.
big_pour.why: When AI accelerates its own development, AI capabilities could advance faster with less human effort.

explain.kid: Anthropic is using smart AI computers to help build even smarter AI computers, and it is working twice as fast as last year.
explain.pm: Anthropic is using its AI models to automate AI development, doubling the rate of model improvement over the past year.
explain.engineer: Anthropic leverages its existing AI models to automate AI development workflows, accelerating model iteration speed to roughly double its rate from a year ago.

big_pour.headline: OpenAI raises $11 billion at $1.25 trillion valuation
big_pour.summary: OpenAI has reportedly raised an additional $11 billion in new funding, bringing the company's valuation to $1.25 trillion.

big_pour.headline: Meta drops plan to train AI on business content
big_pour.summary: Meta abandoned proposed commercial terms that would have required Facebook page owners to allow AI training on their linked website content.

office_blend.headline: Greenlight Financial uses AI agents for security cases
office_blend.summary: Greenlight Financial resolves over 90% of up to 4,000 monthly security and risk cases without human intervention using Luna, a multi-agent system built on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore.

office_blend.headline: National Museum of Korea uses AI for cultural preservation
office_blend.summary: The National Museum of Korea uses AI initiatives and a dedicated digital division to preserve cultural heritage, expand artifact displays, and improve visitor experiences.

still_roasting.summary: Amazon plans to roll out a feature in coming weeks allowing users to text Alexa for shopping help.
Airbnb plans to launch an AI travel agent in the first half of 2027 to help travelers plan and manage trips.
OpenAI president Greg Brockman stated the company could be ready for an initial public offering in 2027.

quick_sips.summary: New Matrix was approved for Nvidia H200 AI chips despite having empty offices in China.
China recruited Megaspeed executive Alice Huang to spy on Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang regarding American AI chips.
UK digital watchdogs warned enterprise companies that they cannot blame AI agents for legal errors.

stories.label: Security model
stories.headline: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Cyber for cybersecurity tasks
stories.summary: OpenAI launched GPT-6 Cyber, its latest model focused on cybersecurity, designed to improve hacking capabilities while enforcing system safety boundaries.

stories.label: Storage acquisition
stories.headline: Dropbox acquiring Tigris for AI developer storage
stories.summary: Dropbox announced plans to acquire Tigris to sell S3-compatible storage targeted at AI developers.

concept.explanation: gVisor is a code sandbox infrastructure project used by Anthropic and OpenAI that Google is donating as an open-source project.

long_read.headline: Scaling Slack and GitHub with Maude Lemaire
long_read.summary: The newsletter highlights insights from Maude Lemaire on scaling Slack and GitHub, optimizing Cursor performance, and keeping human judgment central when using AI.

sign_off: That's the last sip. See you next morning.

word.definition: Data stored as entities and the relationships between them (e.g. Customer → bought → Product), which can be queried by following those links.
word.heard: "Ground the agent on the knowledge graph so it knows which team owns which system."
word.analogy: Like a map of which farm supplies which roaster, which supplies which café.
